description:
Seeking offers over €379,000
This is a newly upgraded and modernised detached home of some 167 sqm set on a broadly rectangular site. On the ground floor is a light filled entrance hall with feature staircase and 5 m high ceiling.  The rear corridor leads to the downstairs living areas and en-suite bedroom.The kitchen/dining room is an open plan area with modern kitchen and new appliances.  There is lots of natural light in this west facing part of the home.  The living room to the end of the house is double aspect with an east and west facing window.  Also on this floor is the Guest WC and downstairs bedroom which has an en-suite and patio doors to the rear garden.On the first floor is the main family bathroom and three well-proportioned bedrooms, one with en-suite.Everything in this home is modern and has been upgraded so if you are looking for a home that is ready to move into and enjoy, within 3 km of both Kilmore Village and Kilmore Quay, this home in Rackardstown should be one to visit.Under 2 km to Kilmore Village and under 3 km to Kilmore Quay.  Electric heating throughout, light filled home, west facing to the rear, septic tank, mains water.  Stone built shed approx. 24 sqm.  Gravelled driveway with ample parking.  Built C. 1977(Please note, the site is being remapped and so differs from landdirect.ie, but the site as outlined in our photo is correct - size to be confirmed)
